packets.title: Plan-mode inventory of the real Bubble app (prerequisite)

steps.title: Inventory the actual Bubble state on test
steps.entities: ALL data_types/, option_sets/, pages/*/workflows, settings/privacy — READ-ONLY
steps.detail: Sync the test branch, then produce a complete inventory of what actually exists in Bubble today: every Data Type with its fields (flagging which lack company/property), every Option Set with counts, every privacy rule (flagging company-only rules), and legacy workflows worth keeping or deleting. NO edits, NO apply — this is discovery.
steps.constraints: Read-only session. Do not modify or apply anything.
steps.verify: Inventory written into brain/database.md, brain/option-sets.md, brain/security.md ("Current state" sections) + one dated brain/changelog.md entry. Everything in brain/ stops being spec-only.
